description: Low-poly voxel model of a particle physics detector on an exhibit plinth: a segmented beam pipe passes through three faceted detector rings, a tracking station with straw tubes, photon detector blocks with cyan hit markers, and a stepped calorimeter wall. A glowing signature particle and curved track show the particle path. Stations can slide apart along the beam axis in a disassembly animation.

interactiveDescriptions.INT_detector_beam_pipe: Segmented beam pipe carrying the particle through the detector.
interactiveDescriptions.INT_detector_tracker: Tracking station: layered plates and straw tubes record the particle's position.
interactiveDescriptions.INT_detector_photon: Photon detector blocks; cyan markers show detected light.
interactiveDescriptions.INT_detector_signature_particle: The signature particle entering the detector; starts the journey.
